t: The provisions of this Act shall take effect on the first day of the first applicable pay period commencing on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.

fable.w: This is purely an effective-date provision tied to a pay period. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: The provisions of this Act shall take effect on the first day of the first applicable pay period commencing on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.
